versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֣רְא הָעָ֔ם כִּֽי־בֹשֵׁ֥שׁ מֹשֶׁ֖ה לָרֶ֣דֶת מִן־הָהָ֑ר וַיִּקָּהֵ֨ל הָעָ֜ם עַֽל־אַהֲרֹ֗ן וַיֹּאמְר֤וּ אֵלָיו֙ ק֣וּם׀ עֲשֵׂה־לָ֣נוּ אֱלֹהִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר יֵֽלְכוּ֙ לְפָנֵ֔ינוּ כִּי־זֶ֣ה׀ מֹשֶׁ֣ה הָאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הֶֽעֱלָ֨נוּ֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם לֹ֥א יָדַ֖עְנוּ מֶה־הָ֥יָה לֽוֹ׃

controles.web: When the people saw that Moses delayed to come down from the mountain, the people gathered themselves together to Aaron, and said to him, “Come, make us gods, which shall go before us; for as for this Moses, the man who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we don’t know what has become of him.”
controles.kjv: And when the people saw that Moses delayed to come down out of the mount, the people gathered themselves together unto Aaron, and said unto him, Up, make us gods, which shall go before us; for as for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.
controles.livre: Mas vendo o povo que Moisés tardava em descer do monte, achegou-se então a Arão, e disseram-lhe: Levanta-te, faze-nos deuses que vão adiante de nós; porque a este Moisés, aquele homem que tirou da terra do Egito, não sabemos o que lhe aconteceu.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵהֶם֙ אַהֲרֹ֔ן פָּֽרְקוּ֙ נִזְמֵ֣י הַזָּהָ֔ב אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּאָזְנֵ֣י נְשֵׁיכֶ֔ם בְּנֵיכֶ֖ם וּבְנֹתֵיכֶ֑ם וְהָבִ֖יאוּ אֵלָֽי׃

controles.web: Aaron said to them, “Take off the golden rings, which are in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your daughters, and bring them to me.”
controles.kjv: And Aaron said unto them, Break off the golden earrings, which are in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your daughters, and bring them unto me.
controles.livre: E Arão lhes disse: Separai os pendentes de ouro que estão nas orelhas de vossas mulheres, e de vossos filhos, e de vossas filhas, e trazei-os a mim.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּתְפָּֽרְקוּ֙ כָּל־הָעָ֔ם אֶת־נִזְמֵ֥י הַזָּהָ֖ב אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּאָזְנֵיהֶ֑ם וַיָּבִ֖יאוּ אֶֽל־אַהֲרֹֽן׃

controles.web: All the people took off the golden rings which were in their ears, and brought them to Aaron.
controles.kjv: And all the people brake off the golden earrings which were in their ears, and brought them unto Aaron.
controles.livre: Então todo o povo separou os pendentes de ouro que tinham em suas orelhas, e trouxeram-nos a Arão:

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקַּ֣ח מִיָּדָ֗ם וַיָּ֤צַר אֹתוֹ֙ בַּחֶ֔רֶט וַֽיַּעֲשֵׂ֖הוּ עֵ֣גֶל מַסֵּכָ֑ה וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ אֵ֤לֶּה אֱלֹהֶ֨יךָ֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶעֱל֖וּךָ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃

controles.web: He received what they handed him, and fashioned it with an engraving tool, and made it a molten calf; and they said, “These are your gods, Israel, which brought you up out of the land of Egypt.”
controles.kjv: And he received them at their hand, and fashioned it with a graving tool, after he had made it a molten calf: and they said, These be thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.
controles.livre: O qual os tomou das mãos deles, e formou-o com buril, e fez disso um bezerro de fundição. Então disseram: Israel, estes são teus deuses, que te tiraram da terra do Egito.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֣רְא אַהֲרֹ֔ן וַיִּ֥בֶן מִזְבֵּ֖חַ לְפָנָ֑יו וַיִּקְרָ֤א אַֽהֲרֹן֙ וַיֹּאמַ֔ר חַ֥ג לַיהוָ֖ה מָחָֽר׃

controles.web: When Aaron saw this, he built an altar before it; and Aaron made a proclamation, and said, “Tomorrow shall be a feast to Yahweh.”
controles.kjv: And when Aaron saw it, he built an altar before it; and Aaron made proclamation, and said, To morrow is a feast to the Lord.
controles.livre: E vendo isto Arão, edificou um altar diante do bezerro; e apregoou Arão, e disse: Amanhã será festa ao SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּשְׁכִּ֨ימוּ֙ מִֽמָּחֳרָ֔ת וַיַּעֲל֣וּ עֹלֹ֔ת וַיַּגִּ֖שׁוּ שְׁלָמִ֑ים וַיֵּ֤שֶׁב הָעָם֙ לֶֽאֱכֹ֣ל וְשָׁת֔וֹ וַיָּקֻ֖מוּ לְצַחֵֽק׃פ

controles.web: They rose up early on the next day, and offered burnt offerings, and brought peace offerings; and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play.
controles.kjv: And they rose up early on the morrow, and offered burnt offerings, and brought peace offerings; and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play.
controles.livre: E no dia seguinte madrugaram, e ofereceram holocaustos, e apresentaram pacíficos: e sentou-se o povo a comer e a beber, e levantaram-se a regozijar-se.

versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֑ה לֶךְ־רֵ֕ד כִּ֚י שִׁחֵ֣ת עַמְּךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶעֱלֵ֖יתָ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, “Go, get down; for your people, who you brought up out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted themselves!
controles.kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, Go, get thee down; for thy people, which thou broughtest out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted themselves:
controles.livre: Então o SENHOR disse a Moisés: Anda, desce, porque teu povo que tiraste da terra do Egito se corrompeu:

versos.hebraico: סָ֣רוּ מַהֵ֗ר מִן־הַדֶּ֨רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּיתִ֔ם עָשׂ֣וּ לָהֶ֔ם עֵ֖גֶל מַסֵּכָ֑ה וַיִּשְׁתַּֽחֲווּ־לוֹ֙ וַיִּזְבְּחוּ־ל֔וֹ וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ אֵ֤לֶּה אֱלֹהֶ֨יךָ֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶֽעֱל֖וּךָ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃

controles.web: They have turned aside quickly out of the way which I commanded them. They have made themselves a molten calf, and have worshiped it, and have sacrificed to it, and said, ‘These are your gods, Israel, which brought you up out of the land of Egypt.’”
controles.kjv: They have turned aside quickly out of the way which I commanded them: they have made them a molten calf, and have worshipped it, and have sacrificed thereunto, and said, These be thy gods, O Israel, which have brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.
controles.livre: Logo se apartaram do caminho que eu lhes mandei, e se fizeram um bezerro de fundição, e o adoraram, e sacrificaram a ele, e disseram: Israel, estes são teus deuses, que te tiraram da terra do Egito.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֑ה רָאִ֨יתִי֙ אֶת־הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה וְהִנֵּ֥ה עַם־קְשֵׁה־עֹ֖רֶף הֽוּא׃

controles.web: Yahweh said to Moses, “I have seen these people, and behold, they are a stiff-necked people.
controles.kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, I have seen this people, and, behold, it is a stiffnecked people:
controles.livre: Disse mais o SENHOR a Moisés: Eu vi a este povo, que por certo é povo de dura cerviz:

versos.hebraico: וְעַתָּה֙ הַנִּ֣יחָה לִּ֔י וְיִֽחַר־אַפִּ֥י בָהֶ֖ם וַאֲכַלֵּ֑ם וְאֶֽעֱשֶׂ֥ה אוֹתְךָ֖ לְג֥וֹי גָּדֽוֹל׃

controles.web: Now therefore leave me alone, that my wrath may burn hot against them, and that I may consume them; and I will make of you a great nation.”
controles.kjv: Now therefore let me alone, that my wrath may wax hot against them, and that I may consume them: and I will make of thee a great nation.
controles.livre: Agora, pois, deixa-me que se acenda meu furor neles, e os consuma: e a ti eu porei sobre grande gente.

versos.hebraico: וַיְחַ֣ל מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶת־פְּנֵ֖י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑יו וַיֹּ֗אמֶר לָמָ֤ה יְהוָה֙ יֶחֱרֶ֤ה אַפְּךָ֙ בְּעַמֶּ֔ךָ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הוֹצֵ֨אתָ֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם בְּכֹ֥חַ גָּד֖וֹל וּבְיָ֥ד חֲזָקָֽה׃

controles.web: Moses begged Yahweh his God, and said, “Yahweh, why does your wrath burn hot against your people, that you have brought out of the land of Egypt with great power and with a mighty hand?
controles.kjv: And Moses besought the Lord his God, and said, Lord, why doth thy wrath wax hot against thy people, which thou hast brought forth out of the land of Egypt with great power, and with a mighty hand?
controles.livre: Então Moisés orou à face do SENHOR seu Deus, e disse: Ó SENHOR, por que se acenderá teu furor em teu povo, que tu tiraste da terra do Egito com grande força, e com mão forte?

versos.hebraico: לָמָּה֩ יֹאמְר֨וּ מִצְרַ֜יִם לֵאמֹ֗ר בְּרָעָ֤ה הֽוֹצִיאָם֙ לַהֲרֹ֤ג אֹתָם֙ בֶּֽהָרִ֔ים וּ֨לְכַלֹּתָ֔ם מֵעַ֖ל פְּנֵ֣י הָֽאֲדָמָ֑ה שׁ֚וּב מֵחֲר֣וֹן אַפֶּ֔ךָ וְהִנָּחֵ֥ם עַל־הָרָעָ֖ה לְעַמֶּֽךָ׃

controles.web: Why should the Egyptians speak, saying, ‘He brought them out for evil, to kill them in the mountains, and to consume them from the surface of the earth?’ Turn from your fierce wrath, and repent of this evil against your people.
controles.kjv: Wherefore should the Egyptians speak, and say, For mischief did he bring them out, to slay them in the mountains, and to consume them from the face of the earth? Turn from thy fierce wrath, and repent of this evil against thy people.
controles.livre: Por que hão de falar os egípcios, dizendo: Para o mal os tirou, para matá-los nos montes, e para exterminá-los de sobre a face da terra? Volta-te do furor de tua ira, e arrepende-te do mal de teu povo.

versos.hebraico: זְכֹ֡ר לְאַבְרָהָם֩ לְיִצְחָ֨ק וּלְיִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל עֲבָדֶ֗יךָ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֣עְתָּ לָהֶם֮ בָּךְ֒ וַתְּדַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵהֶ֔ם אַרְבֶּה֙ אֶֽת־זַרְעֲכֶ֔ם כְּכוֹכְבֵ֖י הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְכָל־הָאָ֨רֶץ הַזֹּ֜את אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֗רְתִּי אֶתֵּן֙ לְזַרְעֲכֶ֔ם וְנָחֲל֖וּ לְעֹלָֽם׃

controles.web: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, your servants, to whom you swore by your own self, and said to them, ‘I will multiply your seed as the stars of the sky, and all this land that I have spoken of I will give to your seed, and they shall inherit it forever.’”
controles.kjv: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, thy servants, to whom thou swarest by thine own self, and saidst unto them, I will multiply your seed as the stars of heaven, and all this land that I have spoken of will I give unto your seed, and they shall inherit it for ever.
controles.livre: Lembra-te de Abraão, de Isaque, e de Israel teus servos, aos quais juraste por ti mesmo, e disse-lhes: Eu multiplicarei vossa semente como as estrelas do céu; e darei a vossa semente toda esta terra que disse, e a tomarão por herança para sempre.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּנָּ֖חֶם יְהוָ֑ה עַל־הָ֣רָעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֖ר לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת לְעַמּֽוֹ׃פ

controles.web: Yahweh repented of the evil which he said he would do to his people.
controles.kjv: And the Lord repented of the evil which he thought to do unto his people.
controles.livre: Então o SENHOR se arrependeu do mal que disse que havia de fazer a seu povo.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּ֜פֶן וַיֵּ֤רֶד מֹשֶׁה֙ מִן־הָהָ֔ר וּשְׁנֵ֛י לֻחֹ֥ת הָעֵדֻ֖ת בְּיָד֑וֹ לֻחֹ֗ת כְּתֻבִים֙ מִשְּׁנֵ֣י עֶבְרֵיהֶ֔ם מִזֶּ֥ה וּמִזֶּ֖ה הֵ֥ם כְּתֻבִֽים׃

controles.web: Moses turned, and went down from the mountain, with the two tablets of the testimony in his hand; tablets that were written on both their sides; on the one side and on the other they were written.
controles.kjv: And Moses turned, and went down from the mount, and the two tables of the testimony were in his hand: the tables were written on both their sides; on the one side and on the other were they written.
controles.livre: E virou-se Moisés, e desceu do monte trazendo em sua mão as duas tábuas do testemunho, as tábuas escritas por ambos os lados; de uma parte e de outra estavam escritas.

versos.hebraico: וְהַ֨לֻּחֹ֔ת מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֖ים הֵ֑מָּה וְהַמִּכְתָּ֗ב מִכְתַּ֤ב אֱלֹהִים֙ ה֔וּא חָר֖וּת עַל־הַלֻּחֹֽת׃

controles.web: The tablets were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, engraved on the tables.
controles.kjv: And the tables were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, graven upon the tables.
controles.livre: E as tábuas eram obra de Deus, e a escritura era escritura de Deus gravada sobre as tábuas.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּשְׁמַ֧ע יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ אֶת־ק֥וֹל הָעָ֖ם בְּרֵעֹ֑ה וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֔ה ק֥וֹל מִלְחָמָ֖ה בַּֽמַּחֲנֶה׃

controles.web: When Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said to Moses, “There is the noise of war in the camp.”
controles.kjv: And when Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said unto Moses, There is a noise of war in the camp.
controles.livre: E ouvindo Josué o clamor do povo que gritava, disse a Moisés: Barulho de batalha há no campo.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר אֵ֥ין קוֹל֙ עֲנ֣וֹת גְּבוּרָ֔ה וְאֵ֥ין ק֖וֹל עֲנ֣וֹת חֲלוּשָׁ֑ה ק֣וֹל עַנּ֔וֹת אָנֹכִ֖י שֹׁמֵֽעַ׃

controles.web: He said, “It isn’t the voice of those who shout for victory, neither is it the voice of those who cry for being overcome; but the noise of those who sing that I hear.”
controles.kjv: And he said, It is not the voice of them that shout for mastery, neither is it the voice of them that cry for being overcome: but the noise of them that sing do I hear.
controles.livre: E ele respondeu: Não é eco de gritos de vitória de fortes, nem eco de gritos de fracos: eu ouço barulho de cantorias.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיְהִ֗י כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר קָרַב֙ אֶל־הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וַיַּ֥רְא אֶת־הָעֵ֖גֶל וּמְחֹלֹ֑ת וַיִּֽחַר־אַ֣ף מֹשֶׁ֗ה וַיַּשְׁלֵ֤ךְ מידו אֶת־הַלֻּחֹ֔ת וַיְשַׁבֵּ֥ר אֹתָ֖ם תַּ֥חַת הָהָֽר׃

controles.web: As soon as he came near to the camp, he saw the calf and the dancing. Then Moses’ anger grew hot, and he threw the tablets out of his hands, and broke them beneath the mountain.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, as soon as he came nigh unto the camp, that he saw the calf, and the dancing: and Moses’ anger waxed hot, and he cast the tables out of his hands, and brake them beneath the mount.
controles.livre: E aconteceu, que quando chegou ele ao acampamento, e viu o bezerro e as danças, acendeu-se a ira a Moisés, e lançou as tábuas de suas mãos, e quebrou-as ao pé do monte.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקַּ֞ח אֶת־הָעֵ֨גֶל אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשׂוּ֙ וַיִּשְׂרֹ֣ף בָּאֵ֔שׁ וַיִּטְחַ֖ן עַ֣ד אֲשֶׁר־דָּ֑ק וַיִּ֨זֶר֙ עַל־פְּנֵ֣י הַמַּ֔יִם וַיַּ֖שְׁקְ אֶת־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: He took the calf which they had made, and burnt it with fire, ground it to powder, and scattered it on the water, and made the children of Israel drink of it.
controles.kjv: And he took the calf which they had made, and burnt it in the fire, and ground it to powder, and strawed it upon the water, and made the children of Israel drink of it.
controles.livre: E tomou o bezerro que fizeram, e queimou-o no fogo, e moeu-o até reduzi-lo a pó, que espalhou sobre as águas, e deu-o a beber aos filhos de Israel.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶֽל־אַהֲרֹ֔ן מֶֽה־עָשָׂ֥ה לְךָ֖ הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֑ה כִּֽי־הֵבֵ֥אתָ עָלָ֖יו חֲטָאָ֥ה גְדֹלָֽה׃

controles.web: Moses said to Aaron, “What did these people do to you, that you have brought a great sin on them?”
controles.kjv: And Moses said unto Aaron, What did this people unto thee, that thou hast brought so great a sin upon them?
controles.livre: E disse Moisés a Arão: Que te fez este povo, que trouxeste sobre ele tão grande pecado?

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אַהֲרֹ֔ן אַל־יִ֥חַר אַ֖ף אֲדֹנִ֑י אַתָּה֙ יָדַ֣עְתָּ אֶת־הָעָ֔ם כִּ֥י בְרָ֖ע הֽוּא׃

controles.web: Aaron said, “Don’t let the anger of my lord grow hot. You know the people, that they are set on evil.
controles.kjv: And Aaron said, Let not the anger of my lord wax hot: thou knowest the people, that they are set on mischief.
controles.livre: E respondeu Arão: Não se ire meu senhor; tu conheces o povo, que é inclinado ao mal.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֣אמְרוּ לִ֔י עֲשֵׂה־לָ֣נוּ אֱלֹהִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֵלְכ֖וּ לְפָנֵ֑ינוּ כִּי־זֶ֣ה׀ מֹשֶׁ֣ה הָאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הֶֽעֱלָ֨נוּ֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם לֹ֥א יָדַ֖עְנוּ מֶה־הָ֥יָה לֽוֹ׃

controles.web: For they said to me, ‘Make us gods, which shall go before us; for as for this Moses, the man who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we don’t know what has become of him.’
controles.kjv: For they said unto me, Make us gods, which shall go before us: for as for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.
controles.livre: Porque me disseram: Faze-nos deuses que vão adiante de nós, que a este Moisés, o homem que tirou da terra do Egito, não sabemos o que lhe aconteceu.

versos.hebraico: וָאֹמַ֤ר לָהֶם֙ לְמִ֣י זָהָ֔ב הִתְפָּרָ֖קוּ וַיִּתְּנוּ־לִ֑י וָאַשְׁלִכֵ֣הוּ בָאֵ֔שׁ וַיֵּצֵ֖א הָעֵ֥גֶל הַזֶּֽה׃

controles.web: I said to them, ‘Whoever has any gold, let them take it off:’ so they gave it to me; and I threw it into the fire, and out came this calf.”
controles.kjv: And I said unto them, Whosoever hath any gold, let them break it off. So they gave it me: then I cast it into the fire, and there came out this calf.
controles.livre: E eu lhes respondi: Quem tem ouro? Separai-o. E o deram a mim, e lancei-o no fogo, e saiu este bezerro.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֤רְא מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת־הָעָ֔ם כִּ֥י פָרֻ֖עַ ה֑וּא כִּֽי־פְרָעֹ֣ה אַהֲרֹ֔ן לְשִׁמְצָ֖ה בְּקָמֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: When Moses saw that the people had broken loose, (for Aaron had let them loose for a derision among their enemies),
controles.kjv: And when Moses saw that the people were naked; (for Aaron had made them naked unto their shame among their enemies:)
controles.livre: E vendo Moisés que o povo estava descontrolado, porque Arão o havia deixado se descontrolarem para vergonha entre seus inimigos,

versos.hebraico: וַיַּעֲמֹ֤ד מֹשֶׁה֙ בְּשַׁ֣עַר הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וַיֹּ֕אמֶר מִ֥י לַיהוָ֖ה אֵלָ֑י וַיֵּאָסְפ֥וּ אֵלָ֖יו כָּל־בְּנֵ֥י לֵוִֽי׃

controles.web: then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, “Whoever is on Yahweh’s side, come to me!”   All the sons of Levi gathered themselves together to him.
controles.kjv: Then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, Who is on the Lord’s side? let him come unto me. And all the sons of Levi gathered themselves together unto him.
controles.livre: Pôs-se Moisés à porta do acampamento, e disse: Quem é do SENHOR? junte-se comigo. E juntaram-se com ele todos os filhos de Levi.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לָהֶ֗ם כֹּֽה־אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שִׂ֥ימוּ אִישׁ־חַרְבּ֖וֹ עַל־יְרֵכ֑וֹ עִבְר֨וּ וָשׁ֜וּבוּ מִשַּׁ֤עַר לָשַׁ֨עַר֙ בַּֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וְהִרְג֧וּ אִֽישׁ־אֶת־אָחִ֛יו וְאִ֥ישׁ אֶת־רֵעֵ֖הוּ וְאִ֥ישׁ אֶת־קְרֹבֽוֹ׃

controles.web: He said to them, “Thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel, ‘Every man put his sword on his thigh, and go back and forth from gate to gate throughout the camp, and every man kill his brother, and every man his companion, and every man his neighbor.’”
controles.kjv: And he said unto them, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, Put every man his sword by his side, and go in and out from gate to gate throughout the camp, and slay every man his brother, and every man his companion, and every man his neighbour.
controles.livre: E ele lhes disse: Assim disse o SENHOR, o Deus de Israel: Ponde cada um sua espada sobre sua coxa: passai e voltai de porta em porta pelo acampamento, e matai cada um a seu irmão, e a seu amigo, e a seu parente.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּֽעֲשׂ֥וּ בְנֵֽי־לֵוִ֖י כִּדְבַ֣ר מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַיִּפֹּ֤ל מִן־הָעָם֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא כִּשְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת אַלְפֵ֖י אִֽישׁ׃

controles.web: The sons of Levi did according to the word of Moses: and there fell of the people that day about three thousand men.
controles.kjv: And the children of Levi did according to the word of Moses: and there fell of the people that day about three thousand men.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Levi o fizeram conforme o dito de Moisés: e caíram do povo naquele dia como três mil homens.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֗ה מִלְא֨וּ יֶדְכֶ֤ם הַיּוֹם֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה כִּ֛י אִ֥ישׁ בִּבְנ֖וֹ וּבְאָחִ֑יו וְלָתֵ֧ת עֲלֵיכֶ֛ם הַיּ֖וֹם בְּרָכָֽה׃

controles.web: Moses said, “Consecrate yourselves today to Yahweh, yes, every man against his son, and against his brother; that he may bestow on you a blessing this day.”
controles.kjv: For Moses had said, Consecrate yourselves to day to the Lord, even every man upon his son, and upon his brother; that he may bestow upon you a blessing this day.
controles.livre: Então Moisés disse: Hoje vos consagrastes ao SENHOR, porque cada um se consagrou em seu filho, e em seu irmão, para que dê ele hoje bênção sobre vós.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִי֙ מִֽמָּחֳרָ֔ת וַיֹּ֤אמֶר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל־הָעָ֔ם אַתֶּ֥ם חֲטָאתֶ֖ם חֲטָאָ֣ה גְדֹלָ֑ה וְעַתָּה֙ אֶֽעֱלֶ֣ה אֶל־יְהוָ֔ה אוּלַ֥י אֲכַפְּרָ֖ה בְּעַ֥ד חַטַּאתְכֶֽם׃

controles.web: On the next day, Moses said to the people, “You have sinned a great sin. Now I will go up to Yahweh. Perhaps I shall make atonement for your sin.”
controles.kjv: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses said unto the people, Ye have sinned a great sin: and now I will go up unto the Lord; peradventure I shall make an atonement for your sin.
controles.livre: E aconteceu que no dia seguinte disse Moisés ao povo: Vós cometestes um grande pecado: mas eu subirei agora ao SENHOR; talvez lhe consiga apaziguar o furor acerca de vosso pecado.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֧שָׁב מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶל־יְהוָ֖ה וַיֹּאמַ֑ר אָ֣נָּ֗א חָטָ֞א הָעָ֤ם הַזֶּה֙ חֲטָאָ֣ה גְדֹלָ֔ה וַיַּֽעֲשׂ֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם אֱלֹהֵ֥י זָהָֽב׃

controles.web: Moses returned to Yahweh, and said, “Oh, this people have sinned a great sin, and have made themselves gods of gold.
controles.kjv: And Moses returned unto the Lord, and said, Oh, this people have sinned a great sin, and have made them gods of gold.
controles.livre: Então voltou Moisés ao SENHOR, e disse: Rogo-te, pois este povo cometeu um grande pecado, porque fizeram para si deuses de ouro,

versos.hebraico: וְעַתָּ֖ה אִם־תִּשָּׂ֣א חַטָּאתָ֑ם וְאִם־אַ֕יִן מְחֵ֣נִי נָ֔א מִֽסִּפְרְךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֥ר כָּתָֽבְתָּ׃

controles.web: Yet now, if you will, forgive their sin—and if not, please blot me out of your book which you have written.”
controles.kjv: Yet now, if thou wilt forgive their sin—; and if not, blot me, I pray thee, out of thy book which thou hast written.
controles.livre: Que perdoes agora seu pecado, e se não, apaga-me agora de teu livro que escreveste.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֑ה מִ֚י אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָֽטָא־לִ֔י אֶמְחֶ֖נּוּ מִסִּפְרִֽי׃

controles.web: Yahweh said to Moses, “Whoever has sinned against me, him will I blot out of my book.
controles.kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, Whosoever hath sinned against me, him will I blot out of my book.
controles.livre: E o SENHOR respondeu a Moisés: Ao que pecar contra mim, a este apagarei eu de meu livro.

versos.hebraico: וְעַתָּ֞ה לֵ֣ךְ׀ נְחֵ֣ה אֶת־הָעָ֗ם אֶ֤ל אֲשֶׁר־דִּבַּ֨רְתִּי֙ לָ֔ךְ הִנֵּ֥ה מַלְאָכִ֖י יֵלֵ֣ךְ לְפָנֶ֑יךָ וּבְי֣וֹם פָּקְדִ֔י וּפָקַדְתִּ֥י עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם חַטָּאתָֽם׃

controles.web: Now go, lead the people to the place of which I have spoken to you. Behold, my angel shall go before you. Nevertheless in the day when I punish, I will punish them for their sin.”
controles.kjv: Therefore now go, lead the people unto the place of which I have spoken unto thee: behold, mine Angel shall go before thee: nevertheless in the day when I visit I will visit their sin upon them.
controles.livre: Vai, pois, agora, leva a este povo aonde te disse: eis que meu anjo irá diante de ti; que no dia de minha visitação eu visitarei neles seu pecado.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּגֹּ֥ף יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־הָעָ֑ם עַ֚ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשׂ֣וּ אֶת־הָעֵ֔גֶל אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה אַהֲרֹֽן׃ס

controles.web: Yahweh struck the people, because they made the calf, which Aaron made.
controles.kjv: And the Lord plagued the people, because they made the calf, which Aaron made.
controles.livre: E o SENHOR feriu ao povo, porque fizeram o bezerro que formou Arão.
